_about: The standard: one row per rule, read by authoring/checks/rules.py (area rules of build.sh check), draftcheck.py (area draft, ga produce, ga drafts) and STANDARD.md. Limits stay in weapons.json checks (limit_ref); a gate rule lists the check items it emits. Terms: inactive = lowered (game Safe), active = raised.

rules.name: Magazine release continuity (reported)
rules.statement: The magazine leaves the gun with the velocity the move gives it: exit speed, release linear and angular impulse, carrier-energy bound are measured and reported per clip.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-13 (SMG round 1): "the magazines' flight/fall speed do not match the amount of force put into the reloads"; owner 2026-11-23: "as little handrolling as possible". pforce and pphys surveys: no separating limit (shipped 172/300 fail an energy bound incl. approved rifles).
rules.population: 654 clips (pphys survey)

enforcement.why: no measure separates the rejected SMG round 1 drafts from approved clips without failing approved ones; negatives are unlabelled (which drafts were rejected for weightless magazines is unrecorded)

rules.name: Loose parts move only while the gun drives them
rules.statement: A part (pump) moves only in frames the gun accelerates (window widened 1 frame each side). Magazine, barrels, shells are reported (judged by R3, R4a).
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-14: "why do you need me to tell you how physics works" (pump slid home after the rise ended); memory reload-drafts, physics causality.
rules.population: survey of 508 clips: pump 0 on every shipped clip

rules.name: Pump closes while the gun moves
rules.statement: Every closing run of the pump has a mean gun speed of at least 0.16 of the clip peak grip speed.
rules.source: Same owner complaint 2026-11-14 (tube picks TU21 to TU23); prefix-tube/SEPARATE.md, SURVEY-XMEAN.md.
rules.population: pump closing runs of the 6 tube pick/gun pairs; approved min 0.172, pre-fix max 0.154 (margin 1.12, labelled weak)

rules.name: Free flight at g
rules.statement: A detached magazine in the air and every uncarried shell outside contact moves at g with constant spin.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-14 physics causality; owner 2026-11-23 "I want this done programatically"; pphys survey (measured noise floor = float rounding).

rules.name: One timing budget per family and take
rules.statement: Clip length and key count at most the family take budget (vanilla dual-wield timing: fire unlocks at the game end time).
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-13: "some of these are super quick while others are incredibly slow as if they were for an LMG/HMG"; owner 2026-11-15 reload-quality-bar (timings = vanilla dual wield).
rules.population: largest value in the survey per family and take

rules.name: Reload time: the hidden window absorbs the stat time
rules.statement: The clip's settle frame at the runtime fit equals round(30 * (S + FireBuffer)), S = ReloadTime + ReloadEndTime (empty: the empty pair) from reload.stats: only the hidden window (hide_start to hide_end) is stretched or cut, at least 12 frames long and at most MaxSpeed; the visible start and the rise are played at speed 1 and the clip has the control's frame count.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-25: reload time is vanilla time; only the off-screen window is stretched or cut, the visible start and end stay frame-identical (paudit/TIMING.md section 3).
rules.population: stats of 11 guns from the TweakDB dump (Warden, Hercules, Borg absent: not measured); script constants FireBuffer 0.2 s, MaxSpeed 8 (GorillaAkimbo.reds)

rules.name: Weapon parts change only off screen and end as vanilla
rules.statement: Every weapon part that acts after the magazine is seated (found by motion in the vanilla reload: cocking handle, bolt, slider, lever, charging handle, lock and mechanism joints of the weapon set) changes state only on frames inside the hidden window (hide_start to hide_end), and on the clip's last frame stands where the vanilla reload leaves it, within the tolerance. The empty reload returns a handle the empty gun locked back, and that return is off screen.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-25: "the cocking handle should be done off screen... on very few select reloads it just randomly shifts where the vanilla reload would've used the left hand to do that, this needs fixing and should become a check"; coordinator reading: the handle part, not a gun jolt.
rules.population: pfix3 measure over 444 shipped, wired and Warden clips (pfix3/a_parts.json): a handle moves on visible frames in most clips of zhuo, dian, saratoga, copperhead, sidewinder, masamune; end state off the vanilla end in zhuo (3.85), dian (1.46), pozhar and crusher (M2 clock), Warden empty (7.5 on the unmapped clock). Tolerance = the stays_moved threshold of timing.py (0.5).
rules.limit: checks.draft.h1 (visible change frames 0, end state within end_tol_cm 0.5; measured on the handle part set hpartset.py builds for the clip, played on the arm clip's keys; component Barrel and the playback clock unverified in game)
rules.scope: reload (guns with a handle part in the weapon set)

rules.name: Break-open hinge opens once and closes once
rules.statement: The barrels of a break-open gun open once (driven by the lever and the swing), stay open while the shells change, and close once. Opens 1, closes 1, no dip over 3 deg below the running maximum between them.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-15 (in-game, Igla first): barrels flap open and shut many times and many shells eject at once. pshot 2026-11-25: _hinge_deg of the 36 shipped break drafts opens 2 to 3 times (dip 28 to 51 deg), the hinge simulation bounces (ejector springs, gravity, the gun's stops).
rules.population: 36 shipped break drafts (right hand, male V): 36 of 36 fail before drive_hinge, 0 after (pshot/hinge_pma_shipped.txt)
rules.scope: reload (break-open guns: Igla, Palica, Satara, Testera)

rules.name: Tossed gun is in pure free flight
rules.statement: While the gun is not held (toss), its centre of mass follows a gravity parabola and it spins at a constant rate about a fixed axis; no hand contact.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-25 (Carnage toss-cock: throw, half turn, catch by the pump, rack, throw back, catch by the grip), standard: physics per the brief
rules.population: 4 Carnage toss-cock clips (pshot flick2.py): all pass; no shipped clip has a toss

rules.name: Catches put the hand on the part with matched velocity
rules.statement: At a catch the hand coincides with the part it takes (fore-end point, pistol grip) and moves with it (relative speed under the limit); no teleport. The pump moves only while the hand holds it. The whole cycle fits the Carnage CycleTime.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-25 (Carnage toss-cock: throw, half turn, catch by the pump, rack, throw back, catch by the grip), standard: physics per the brief
rules.population: 4 Carnage toss-cock clips (pshot flick2.py): all pass; no shipped clip has a toss

rules.name: Lowered end transition is one move to the lowered idle
rules.statement: In the lowered stance the last rise ends in the lowered idle: after the last frame with at least 0.25 of the peak speed there are at most 7 frames of slow drift (gun speed 0.15 to 0.5 cm/f). Holding still after the rise is fine; drifting is not.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-25: "the reloads in the lowered stance have this long awkward settle where it's pretty obvious the reload was made for active stance and then the gun VERY slowly moves to the lowered stance... The Hercules is the worst offender... the Zhuo on the other hand ... is perfect"; Warden variants "literally perfect" (2026-11-24).
rules.population: 69 lowered clips: Warden ST32B/ST38B/ST40B 1 to 6 and Zhuo SF35B 7, SF40B 4 (pass: owner-approved); Zhuo SF13B 9 (fail: owner 2026-11-25 rejects its long settle); Hercules H13B/H14B/H16B 25 to 31 (fail); also fail: sidewinder F02/F09/F16 empty (19 to 24), copperhead F02/F09/F16 empty (12 to 15)

rules.name: Smoothness: the arm chain is no rougher than the shipped clip
rules.statement: After the hidden window the clavicle, upper arm, forearm and hand of a variant move as fluidly as in the shipped clip it is made from: the clavicle jerk, the chain jerk and the clavicle acceleration sign changes rise over the shipped clip by at most the limits. No rate-limited constant-velocity steps, no sawtooth. Lowered rises: the visible upper arm and forearm peak and jerk after hide_end are at most the approved lowered variants' worst ratio to their source x 1.1 (checks.draft.s1.arm_ratio_max: upper arm 1.23 / 1.84, forearm 1.20 / 1.21), a diagnostic, not a gate (the build's rise search used it; the owner accepted Hercules H14 native at forearm ratios 1.74-2.02, jerk up to 3.07, which it rejects); the arm bounds measured on the 12 approved Warden lowered variants and the SV13/SV14 lowered clips against their source.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-25: "you sped up the settling... those reloads look garbage, as if the guns have no weight, extremely jittery. Vanilla reloads per gun are way more fluid."
rules.population: no absolute measure separates the owner-rejected follow-rise clips from the shipped set (shipped worst >= rejected worst for jerk, sign changes, corners and plateaus of every arm joint); gun and hand screen jerk fails 113 of 220 shipped clips; see the reason; diagnostic evidence (2026-11-26): Zhuo SF35B (owner-approved) passes the arm bounds (upper arm 1.00-1.03 / 0.78-1.12, forearm 1.06-1.10 / 0.77-1.15, pma and pwa, both hands); Hercules H14 native (owner viewed it in reel_native and did not object) fails them (forearm 1.74-2.02 / 1.17-3.07, upper arm 1.34-1.40 / 0.83-2.21), so the bound is reported, not enforced
rules.scope: reload variants (lowvar), control = the shipped clip of the same name

enforcement.why: measured (authoring/checks/smooth.py, pfix3/arm_cal*.json): relative to the shipped clip the arm chain separates perfectly in the raised stance (approved Warden +0.1 clavicle jerk, pvar raised 0) but not in the lowered stance, where lowering itself raises the clavicle jerk (approved Warden lowered +6.5, rejected follow-rise median +2.1, max +12.5); against the no-clamp build of the same pick the rejected clips fail 30 of 34 and nothing approved is paired; the arm-ratio bound (checks.draft.s1.arm_ratio_max) is a diagnostic: the owner-accepted Hercules H14 native fails it, the approved Zhuo SF35B and Warden variants pass

rules.name: Fresh magazine does not move by itself
rules.statement: A fresh magazine with no contact is still or in free flight at g, counted on the frames in which the magazine is in the game frame (physics nobody can see is not a defect; same camera as R9).
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-14 physics causality; pphys gate set.
rules.population: 654 clips; the frames it moves on (ST32B variants 3, shipped pulsar SB38/39/43 4 to 5, shipped Warden ST38B 5) are all outside the game frame

rules.name: Weight: grip pace and stop loss
rules.statement: Lower bounds per family: peak grip speed of the longest big move per cm of its length, and the speed lost in the hardest stop. No upper bounds. Lowered-stance variants (clips with a lowered overlay, spec _lowered): only the big moves that end by hide_end count, i.e. the motion identical to the source; the visible rise after hide_end is not a weight stop (owner-approved lowered rises stop softly).
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-12 (rifle round 1): "weird momentum" and no weight; 2026-11-13 "wind up chop is by far the best".
rules.population: survey minimum x 0.9 over the 396 shipped and parked clips (per family); lowered rise evidence (pfix3/rise_r5.py): the 12 approved Warden lowered variants' visible rises have stop loss 0.7 to 3.4 (median 1.3) and grip pace 0.143 to 0.170, SV13/SV14 lowered 2.1 to 2.2 and 0.138 to 0.139; the Hercules rises: shipped 7.5 / 0.256, 0 extra frames 6.2 / 0.222, +2 frames 3.5 / 0.183, +4 frames 2.3 / 0.183. A rise hard enough for the Hercules floor (6.4) makes the forearm jerk 5 times the shipped clip's (pfix3 stop-shaped rise: 35.2 against 7.0).
rules.limit: checks.draft.r5_min; lowered variants: checks.draft.r5_min_lowered (the worst pre-hide_end stop loss and grip pace of the family's shipped clips x 0.9, never above the family's R5 floor: the scope change does not tighten any family; Hercules 3.5 / 0.179 because H14's pre-hide stops are soft, 3.9; lowered variants are not identical to their source before hide_end: the lowered start fade changes the pre-hide path, e.g. the Pulsar variants' grip pace 0.131 against a shipped-calibrated 0.162)
rules.scope: reload; lowered variants: the motion before hide_end (the visible rise is judged by L1, the approved-lowered arm bounds checks.draft.s1.arm_ratio_max and the S1 diagnostics)

rules.name: Start and end in the idle the game returns to
rules.statement: First and last frame equal the stance idle (position and rotation), and the last step is not a jump.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-07 (memory anim-transitions): "the right arm ending too far inward ... snapping to its idle position afterwards"; owner 2026-11-24: "renders and clips must start and end in the lowered idle" (lowered variants).
rules.population: shipped worst 0.003 cm, 0.007 deg
rules.stance: both (the idle of the stance the clip plays in)

rules.name: Finger torque of in-hand turns
rules.statement: Net finger torque (I alpha minus the gravity moment) on the frames where the gun turns in the hand at most the limit: heavy guns are not spun by the fingers. Frames where the gun does not turn in the hand (below 0.5 deg/f) and is held are arm-driven: judged against the approved arm-driven range, at most 100 N m. Free-flight steps (a tossed gun, spec _free_flights) are exempt.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-23: "All too slow (except the full spins, those feel too light)"; "when do we decide whether we do arm based swings vs fingers? ... in the pipeline" (ptorque, ptorque2).
rules.population: Warden ST32B (4 clips), the one approved in-hand turn; Warden mass and inertia from the mesh

rules.name: Sustained speed
rules.statement: Lower bounds on gun path and 90th percentile gun speed, whole clip and release phase, per family and take: a slow clip with one fast frame fails.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-23: "These are all too slow ... The old animations we made for this gun were much better" (pst32 round); measured 2.0 vs 1.6 cm/f.
rules.population: shipped and parked clips per family and take, worst x 0.9; top B release rows: the 24 approved Warden variants worst x 0.9 (15.32 cm, 1.10 cm/f, changed 2026-11-24, see weapons.json _notes.r8_min)

rules.name: Discard visible
rules.statement: From the magazine release to the frame the magazine is free of the well, every joint of the reloading hand is in the game camera frame and the magazine well is in the frame on at least 0.8 of those frames. Gates only the discard-visible variants that are made (R18); where the lift needed is not natural no variant is made, the shipped clip stays in that stance and R9 does not apply (owner 2026-11-24: not required for every reload, never for very large guns).
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24: "the discarding animation needs to be visible on screen, so for the discarding animation the weapon must be raised into view before going off-screen"; "ok but these reloads all have their discard animations off-screen? what happened to what we did earlier?"; calibrated on the approved clips (pstd/cal).
rules.population: approved 24 Warden variants (hand >= 0.024, well share 0.8 to 1.0), SV13/SV14 finals (hand 0.22 to 0.51, well 1.0); rejects ST55B/58B/59B/63B (well 0 of 3)
old_names: phook coverage target (replaced: fails every approved clip)

rules.name: Arm swing speed
rules.statement: Peak swing speed of clavicle, shoulder, elbow, wrist at most the limit: a joint that turns faster than any shipped clip in one frame reads as a snap.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24: "ST55B is way too robotic, no one moves their arms like that"; ST55B, ST58B, ST59B, ST63B "WAY too robotic" (parm).
rules.population: 396 shipped and parked clips, worst x 1.1 for clavicle, shoulder, elbow; wrist 94.1 = the approved set worst (ST38B variants, 85.54) x 1.1 (round 3); rejected wrist 90.4/89.0/64.5/48.4 now pass R10 and fail other gates

rules.name: Two-gun clearance
rules.statement: The clip mirrored onto the other hand: gun and arm points stay inside the lateral and inward reach so two guns reloading at once do not conflict.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24 (SV10): "extends outward too far, so if 2 guns were reloaded at the same time this would likely conflict".
rules.population: 24 approved Warden variants (inward min -2.29 cm, lateral max 60.2 cm); SV10 fails

rules.name: Speed caps (no rushed second half)
rules.statement: Post-seat gun speed, gun acceleration and hand speed, and the whole-clip peaks, at most the family set.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24 (SV10, SV13): "the 2nd half of the reload ... happens WAY too quick, so human can move that quick. From frame 47 onward".
rules.population: top: 24 approved Warden variants x 1.1; other families: shipped and vanilla x 1.1

rules.name: No dead pause
rules.statement: No run of near-still gun frames longer than 5 between the release and hide_start.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24 (SV10, SV13): "very awkward pause once the mag is flung".
rules.population: shipped discard phases, worst 5 frames

rules.name: Hidden phase never visible; no spin on screen
rules.statement: From hide_start to the rise beat no gun, hand or arm point is in the frame, and the gun spin on the first visible frames after it is capped.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24: "the spin animation which should occur off-screen (& given it's off-screen, it shouldn't happen at all) is shown slightly on screen which is really jarring".
rules.population: 24 approved Warden variants (spin peak 31 deg/f, 115.4 deg at entry); Warden mesh

rules.name: Natural lift (a variant is made only where the lift looks natural)
rules.statement: The offset (and pitch) the solver needs to bring the discard into view is at most the approved Warden variants worst x 1.1; above it no variant is made for that gun and stance and the shipped clip stays.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24 (coordinator): "showing the discard is NOT required for every reload, and never for very large guns (LMGs etc.): lifting them into view does not look natural"; measured from the approved data, no hand categories.
rules.population: approved Warden variants: stop offset 42.3 cm (ST38B), pitch 21.62 deg
rules.limit: offset <= 46.5 cm, pitch <= 23.8 deg (checks.draft.std lift_*; discard.py refuses a larger lift)

rules.name: Too steady (robotic) motion
rules.statement: A draft must be at least as unsteady as the steadiest vanilla reload: tremor, speed variation, path straightness, direction changes over every move segment.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24 (coordinator): "robotic" = "surgically steady moves, completely linear, as if moved by a machine. Vanilla reloads never move that way: they have shaking, nudging, varying speeds and angles."
rules.population: 132 vanilla clips; floor = vanilla worst x 0.9

enforcement.why: measured in pstd/steady (7 features, 130 vanilla clips, 64 approved, 4 rejected): no feature separates the rejected four from vanilla and the approved clips. Floors fail 16 to 64 of 64 approved clips or pass all four rejected; the rejected are more jittery than the approved on gun rotation tremor. Retry on visible frames only (pstd/steady2, 2026-11-24 follow-up): the rejected clips show 36 to 58 of 77 frames, segments survive, and still no feature fails all four rejected and passes every approved clip (the ones that fail all four also fail 32 of 40 approved). Wrist snaps (R10) are the measured part of "robotic".

rules.name: Robotic fling
rules.statement: The magazine fling reads as a human throw, not a machine move.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24 (SV10): "the way its flung is too robotic"; pvan2: release-phase straightness, constant-speed run and acceleration spikes do not rank within the shipped clips.
rules.population: owner ranking SV10 worst, SV13 better, SV14 fine

enforcement.why: no measure ranks the fling; judged by eye at pick time (real-speed video)

rules.name: Magazine mass and force (SMG)
rules.statement: A magazine thrown fast comes from a hard move, a dropped one from a tip; exit speed fits the force behind it.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-13: "the magazines' flight/fall speed do not match the amount of force put into the reloads". pforce, pphys.
rules.population: shipped and rejected drafts

enforcement.why: no separator: ratio bands fail approved clips; negatives were not labelled; the physics rules R3 and R4a cover continuity and flight only. Owner eye plus the R1 report.

rules.name: Inactive (lowered) pose family from the measured length
rules.statement: Lowered pose v1d when the assembled gun is longer than 90 cm, else v1; applies only if a tune passes every lowered check, else the other family.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-23: ""or an assault rifle" should not be a criterium, this should be determined programatically"; "we don't do exceptions"; poses shared like reload families.
rules.population: shipped guns, ppose survey (carnage 85.8 / igla 92.8)

rules.name: Active (raised) pose family from the measured cover
rules.statement: Raised pose C when the idle screen cover in the game raised pose exceeds 8.5 %, else the game pose.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-23 as P1; 2026-11-24 "the active poses will see their guns lowered and spaced out further depending on how big they are ... No exceptions?"
rules.population: shipped guns (saratoga 8.2 / copperhead 8.8)

rules.name: Lowered pose clip limits
rules.statement: Eye distance, gun gap, wrist bend and loop seam of the lowered idle and clips within the limits.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-23 pose approval ("the after poses you sent looked good"); limits fitted to the shipped poses (carnage/satara gap 17.6 cm is a baseline).
rules.population: shipped lowered poses

rules.name: Raised pose limits
rules.statement: Cover at or under the family target, eye distance, aim eye distance, reach, wrist, gun gap, muzzle direction, hand on the grip.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-23 pose approval; limits from the shipped raised poses (eye_aim_min 16.7 = game aim pose).
rules.population: five shipped raised poses

rules.name: Poses do not change for the discard
rules.statement: Reload variants start and end in the existing inactive or active idle; only the discard rise is added.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24: "We don't want to create actual changes in the active/inactive poses, we ONLY wanted the guns raised into view for the discarding animation".
rules.population: approved variants (R6 0.000)

rules.name: Discard rule on the stance variants (lowvar)
rules.statement: The calibrated R9 (hand margin and well share in the discard window) measured on every variant clip of the manifest in both stances, both bodies, both hands; wrist from the bind pose at most 72.7 deg; the generator gate rules (start and end in the stance idle, hidden window, reach, shoulder, eye).
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24 "These newer ones are literally perfect ... Going forward this is the standard" (plift4); R9 calibration in pstd/cal replaces the phook coverage target.
rules.population: 24 approved Warden variants per stance (hand >= 0.024, well share >= 0.8)

rules.name: The clip that plays in each stance passes R9
rules.statement: Every stance must play a clip that passes R9. A gun with a lowered variant needs its raised variant wired: the sets the gun plays when it is not lowered are built from the raised variant clips (reload.raised_variant clips and layout; rreload.played), so the shipped clips are frozen inputs (A2), not outputs.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24: "Rule now: discard visible in every stance" (PLAN log); "ok but these reloads all have their discard animations off-screen?"
rules.population: ffcaf01 wired the lowered variants; the raised variants are wired in the manifest, genguns and rreload (draft, not built, not tested in game)

rules.name: Lowered stance variant per gun (ga produce)
rules.statement: ga produce builds the lowered variant for every gun with a lowered stance; exit 3 (no discard hook) is reported, never silent.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24: "yes do it" (pipeline step for every gun with a lowered stance).
rules.population: plow, phook: Warden + 8 families built, ajax and dian SF40A blocked

enforcement.label: lowered variants
enforcement.where: ga.py step lowered variants (ok_codes 0,3: reported as NOT MADE)

rules.name: End pose gate (arm clips)
rules.statement: Last frame equals the idle pose per hand, frames before the seated frame unchanged by the end-pose fix.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-07 (anim-transitions).
rules.population: shipped worst 0.003 cm, 0.007 deg

rules.name: Reload gate rules (rgate)
rules.statement: Hidden window present and long enough, handle hit outside the frame, no magazine on screen after hide_start, no magazine hanging, eye distance, cover, wrist, reach, shoulder pull, body, gap to the other gun.
rules.source: Owner rules of 2026-11-07 to 11-15 (memory reload-drafts, anim-transitions); gate numbers in checks.rreload (limits are shipped worst).
rules.population: shipped rifle and SMG clips

rules.name: Top-magazine clips and magazine tracks
rules.statement: Top-magazine arm clips and written magazine sets pass the flight, contact and hidden gates.
rules.source: Owner rules 2026-11 (Shingen top-magazine knock; magazine flight).
rules.population: shipped sets; baselines recorded in magtrack/baseline.json (shipped misses)

rules.name: Build integrity
rules.statement: Manifest inputs not temporary, anim sets are SIMD with the glb key count, parts sets rebuild.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-22/23: build inputs get a permanent home; no temp paths.
rules.population: weapons.json paths

rules.name: Rules manifest integrity
rules.statement: rules.json: unique ids, every field filled, every gate rule resolves to a running check and a limit, no rule only in notes.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24: "the rules are enforced checks, not notes".
rules.population: rules.json

rules.name: Approved outputs reproduce
rules.statement: The owner-approved clips are what the pipeline makes: the 24 lowered and 24 raised Warden variants and the SV13 and SV14 finals (glb, track, gate) equal their committed sha256 (approved.json). ga produce warden and ga drafts top --from-vanilla --only SV13,SV14 write the same bytes (pstd 2026-11-24).
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24: "Going forward this is the standard" (variants), "fantastic, the new standard" (SV13, SV14); coordinator: keep outputs of approved clips unchanged.
rules.population: 192 files

rules.name: Shipped base clips are frozen inputs
rules.statement: The shipped Warden base clips and fallbacks are committed inputs with hashes; the current generators do not reproduce them (ga produce regenerates ST32B and ST40B base clips that differ and fail R8 and R10), and the variants are built from the shipped clips, not from regenerated ones.
rules.source: Coordinator 2026-11-24: freeze the shipped base clips as committed inputs; do not make the generator match them.
rules.population: 120 files (glb, track, gate, spec json)

rules.name: Review video at real speed
rules.statement: Review and approval videos play at 30 fps (real speed) first, half speed only as a second.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24 (memory reload-drafts: "Show videos at real speed (30 fps), not half").
rules.population: pvan2 renders

enforcement.why: render tools write whatever fps the caller passes; a check on the produced mp4 is not written (media are made in Blender by hand-run tools)

rules.name: Footage masters
rules.statement: In-game masters of all features: 2560x1440, 60 fps, high quality mp4, kept as source; body scaling off, HUD off, saves backed up, owner not playing.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24: "the footage we record needs to be 2k 60fps mp4 that we can reuse for our portfolio or to take gifs of, but the source material should be there, high quality".
rules.population: Phase 8 deliverable

enforcement.why: Phase 8 is not run yet; ga ingame --record has no resolution or fps check on the file

rules.name: Nexus media standard
rules.statement: Uniform screenshot scaling, one compact aligned kb|pad image per feature, clean main-menu gallery shots, page text for new users.
rules.source: Memory mod-page-standard, mod-page-design (owner approvals).
rules.population: Nexus/GitHub pages

enforcement.why: page layout is judged by eye at publish time

rules.name: Variety and review batches
rules.statement: About 10 drafts per batch for the owner to pick; when one draft is named the only good one, the next batch is 10 genuinely different techniques, not variations of it.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13 ("every single animation you made is based on the windmill, this is NOT what I asked").
rules.population: rounds

enforcement.why: ga drafts warns on batch size; technique variety is not measurable

rules.name: At most 3 variants per reload set
rules.statement: A reload set holds reload, _01, _02: ga pick records at most 3 picks.
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-11; game animation set layout.
rules.population: weapons.json reload.slots

enforcement.where: drafts.py pick (slots = picks repeated up to 3)

rules.name: Vanilla reloads as the reference for new drafts
rules.statement: New drafts start from the game's own reloads (one-handed directly, two-handed translated to one hand).
rules.source: Owner 2026-11-24: "what would be nice is if we took vanilla's reloads as a reference".
rules.population: pvanilla: 132 clips, 6 one-handed
